name: tor-js-anon-rpc-worker
description: An anon-rpc worker (SPEC.md §3.2) that services fetch calls over Tor via tor-js. It runs inside anon-rpc's sandboxed worker and reaches the network only through the host-granted KPS transport — bundled to a single hash-pinned IIFE with the WASM embedded and no @kpstreams client code.
